clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Acid rain hisses across neon concrete as your ocular HUD locks onto the street ahead. Stay sharp, runner.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Clean execution. The security node flickers green and yields its hidden data without tripping a single alarm.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Static spikes across your visor. The lock rejects your override, and footsteps echo from the corridor behind you.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Targeting reticles flare crimson. Hostiles are closing fast—roll initiative and pick your cover.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: The city hums in the rain while your neural link processes the next move. Check your HUD feed for details.

clips.speaker: corpo-generic
clips.text: You have thirty seconds of billable time. State your contract credentials or security will escort you out.

clips.speaker: corpo-generic
clips.text: My encrypted channel is throttled. Review the dossier on your visor and confirm when ready.

clips.speaker: street-generic
clips.text: Keep your chrome holstered and your voice low. You brought the Wonlongs, or are you wasting my night?

clips.speaker: street-generic
clips.text: Comms are jammed down here, choom. Read the feed on your screen and move before the drones sweep past.

clips.speaker: synth-generic
clips.text: Biometric handshake verified. My tactical subroutines are online and awaiting your next directive.

clips.speaker: synth-generic
clips.text: Voice uplink bandwidth exceeded. Switching to local cached telemetry. Read your HUD readout to proceed.
